notes: 🎯 Best Evidence Today gets the same two fixes as Climbers. Rows are now two lines — number, code, chip, price and score on the first line, the name and the evidence detail on a full-width second line — so nothing gets squeezed into one word per line on a phone. And the heading now describes the real ranking: by the best line's edge (money per $100 beyond the market), then by how many proven lines fired. The SOLID/PROMISING badge gets a share onto the list but doesn't decide the order — which is why a bigger PROMISING edge can sit above a smaller SOLID one. Ranking unchanged; only the layout and the words.
